english.note: Use this when an engine, weapon, storm, or other inanimate thing makes a loud resounding or rumbling noise.

jyutping: A gwang1 lung4 lung4 gam3 hoeng2

examples.english: The bus begins to roar as soon as it starts moving.
examples.traditional: 架巴士一開動就轟隆隆咁響。
examples.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 jat1 hoi1 dung6 zau6 gwang1 lung4 lung4 gam3 hoeng2
